remarks: Welcome home to this bright and beautifully updated 2-bedroom, 1-bath condominium in Stamford's desirable Glenbrook neighborhood. Conveniently located just minutes from the Glenbrook Metro-North station, this home offers an easy commute and close proximity to shopping, restaurants, parks, and everyday conveniences.  Inside, you'll find hardwood floors throughout, abundant natural light, and a thoughtfully updated interior. The renovated bathroom features luxurious heated floors, while the spacious layout includes two well-sized bedrooms and a welcoming living area. Additional amenities include a shared washer and dryer in the basement, one off-street parking space and storage space in the basement. With no rental restrictions, this property is an excellent opportunity for both owner-occupants and investors. Also available for rent.
